zh-CN.title: 探索也会留下成长
items: 首次体验聊天中的更多能力可获得成长值
发言、评论、回复和互动也会记录成长
所有探索奖励只结算一次，重复操作不会刷分

en.title: Exploration now fuels growth
items: Trying more chat features for the first time earns growth points
Statements, comments, replies, and interactions now count too
Each exploration reward is granted only once
